excerpt.zh:
认知微处理器、增强的人工智能家教、促进神经可塑性再生的设计酶——这些都还只是为学龄前学生准备的。

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
excerpt.en:
Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs.

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
texts.en:
Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs. The performance gap is widening between those who rely on public augments and households that can afford cutting-edge technology.

Maintaining an equitable system will require a significant, five-year investment of resources.

texts.zh:
认知微处理器、增强的人工智能家教、促进神经可塑性再生的设计酶——这些都还只是为学龄前学生准备的。

好的教育可以相当昂贵，而许多人感觉越来越难以跟上脚步了。然而那些能享用最尖端强化改造的有钱人家和只能依赖二手或者仿冒模块的人之间的差距还在越变越大。

为了避免进一步的社会分层，有必要对我们的教育系统进行一项重大的五年投资。
texts.en:
Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

A good education can be expensive, and many are finding it increasingly difficult to keep pace. The performance gap is widening between households that can afford cutting edge augmentation and those that must rely on older, hand-me-down, or knock-off models.

To prevent further social stratification, it will be necessary to make a significant, five-year investment in our education system.

label.zh: 教育就应该惠及所有人。
label.en: Education must remain accessible to all.

tooltips.zh: 我们会发起一项五年计划，促生一种强韧且全面强化的教育系统。
tooltips.en: We will embark on a five-year program to promote a robust and fully-augmented education system.

label.zh: 教育就应该惠及所有人。
label.en: Education must remain accessible to all.

tooltips.zh: 我们会发起一项五年计划，促生一种强韧且全面强化的教育系统。
tooltips.en: We will embark on a five-year program to promote a robust and fully-augmented education system.

texts.zh:
事实证明，不动用公共资金去资助教育强化件的决定是明智的。

我们的社会崇尚个人卓越。尽管对不断扩大的“社会鸿沟”的批评不绝于耳，但从学术竞争中却脱颖而出了一些全星系受教育程度最高、最具生产力的领袖。
texts.en:
The decision to refrain from publicly funding educational augmentation has proven a wise one.

Ours is a society that believes in individual excellence. Despite scattered criticism about the widening 'social divide', academic competition has resulted in some of the most highly-educated and productive leaders in the galaxy.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 在个人层面发展我们最有天赋的人防创造了一条培养品质杰出领袖的途径。
tooltips.en: Developing our best talent on an individual level has created a pipeline for leaders of exceptional quality.

texts.zh:
我们在教育强化件方面的投资取得了可观的回报。

开放公众对高质量义体的获取创造了一种真正的学术精英统治，在这种秩序下，每个人——无论其社会阶层——都能充分发挥自己的潜力。这些好处在科学领域尤为明显，科研产出和创新水平全面提高。
texts.en:
Our investment in educational augmentation has paid off handsomely.

Public access to high-quality cybernetics has created a true academic meritocracy in which everyone - no matter their social class - can achieve their full potential. The benefits are particularly noticeable in the sciences, where research output and innovation have improved across the board.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 高度受教育的强化人口是社会和物质进步的关键。
tooltips.en: A well-educated and fully augmented population is the key to social and material progress.

# 提高成绩 / Making the Grade

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链中段：网络化局势结束后 cyber.500 选出 505–525 之一，约180+随机90天后隐藏事件 cyber.600 从 on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list（11个事件，权重各5：工作 610/615/625/655，家庭 805/810/815/820/830/840/855）抽取一个。
  Middle of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the Cyberization situation ends cyber.500 picks one of 505-525; about 180 days (+ random 90) later hidden cyber.600 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list (11 events, weight 5 each: work 610/615/625/655, family 805/810/815/820/830/840/855).
- 无额外触发条件；选项按国家标志 cyber_control_government / _corporate / _independent 出现。
  No extra trigger; options appear by country flags cyber_control_government / _corporate / _independent.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 855「做个好学生」：政府控制线选项 → 865「杰出领袖」；企业/独立线选项（cyber_education，平等主义有加成）→ 860「平等的卓越」；各自180+随机90天后 cyber.1000。
  855 "Making the Grade": the government-control options lead to 865 "Exceptional Leaders"; the corporate / independent options (cyber_education; egalitarian bonus) lead to 860 "Egalitarian Excellence"; each then reaches cyber.1000 after 180 days (+ random 90).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 860 与 865 互斥（取决于控制权标志）。
  860 and 865 are exclusive (decided by the control flag).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 控制权标志来自网络化局势阶段事件（见起源故事）。
  The control flags come from the Cyberization stage events (see that story).
